name: slicerbridge
description: Convert a multicolor 3MF project into a ready, checked file for every multicolor printer: Bambu Lab, Creality, Elegoo, Anycubic, Flashforge, QIDI, WonderMaker, Prusa and the Snapmaker U1.

orcaslicer.title: OrcaSlicer location
orcaslicer.description: Where OrcaSlicer 2.4.2, which writes the files for Creality, Elegoo, Anycubic, Flashforge and QIDI printers is installed: the .app on macOS, or its executable. Leave empty to look in /Applications.
